spans.text: Have you confirmed SOP-II's location, Makarov?
Da, she is exchanging fire with Dreamer's troops in an abandoned factory.
Things are not too bad at the moment, but we can't tell when Dreamer will intervene.
Then let's sever communications among different Sangvis echelons first to prevent them from getting reinforcements.
Agreed. The nearest communication outpost is around this area. Quite a large amount of data traffic.
Taking this base will do both SOP-II and ourselves good.
Commander, please do us the favor of seizing the base.
We'll be on standby here until they finish their game of cat-and-mouse.
